high_level_description: This image depicts a dramatic scene of a large explosion occurring over a body of water, likely a harbor or a dock area. The explosion is intense, with bright orange and yellow flames and thick smoke billowing upwards, creating a mushroom cloud effect. The sky above the explosion is filled with dark clouds, adding to the ominous atmosphere. In the foreground, there are several ships and boats. On the left side, there is a large ship with a prominent mast and what appears to be a crane or some kind of industrial equipment on its deck.
